children: LSB Industries reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $158.6 million, up 2% from a year earlier, while net income rose to $16.3 million from $7.1 million and diluted EPS increased to $0.22 from $0.1.
Revenue was $158.6M, compared with $155.4M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 2.0%.
Net income was $16.3M, compared with $7.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 129.8%.
Diluted EPS was $0.22, compared with $0.10 in the prior-year quarter.
Gross profit increased 69%, with improved pricing and precious-metal recovery contributing to the gain.
Sales of ammonia nitrate and nitric acid grew 41% as production shifted away from UAN. UAN sales fell 61%, reflecting the product mix change and downtime at Pryor.
LSB completed the El Dorado ammonia turnaround in the second quarter and Pryor’s turnaround in early third quarter. Cherokee turnaround work is planned for the third quarter of 2027.
The company assumed full ownership of its El Dorado carbon-capture project. EPA permit review is ongoing, and operations are targeted to begin as early as 2027.
Management expects nitrogen demand to remain robust through fall 2026 and spring 2027, supported by mining demand and constructive fertilizer markets.
